slides.texte_overlay:
“i always start studying
the night before”
same. here's the 5-day plan that fixed it:

day 1: 15 minutes to list what's on the test.
that's all. starting is the hard part.

day 2 and 3: one part of the list per day.
30 minutes, then i stop.

day 4: i quiz myself on everything, notes closed.
what i miss becomes tomorrow's only job.

day 5 (the night before): just the mistakes from day 4.
then bed.

same hours as one panicked night.
way less stress.
